ten_cloud_rooms.scope: Ten independent browser network contexts, real HTTPS gateway and Linx STT/MCP/TTS; identical prerecorded PCM input; no speaker/audibility claim

scene_load.note: Room 1 was changed by its user from rollers to duo before deployment. Same-scene comparison therefore uses an independent room 2; each condition has one fresh-context visit and one reload, not a percentile study.

boundaries: Official meshes and real in-process MuJoCo CPU/ONNX; no physical robot acceptance
